ploidyspec report: OncMaso1_wu2026

Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

2 haplotype copies of each of 33 chromosome numbers; an older duplication shows on part of the genome (8 whole-chromosome homeolog pairs, 22% of the genome in homeolog blocks), too little to read duplicated sets from.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (2 per number); 8 whole-chromosome homeolog pairs, 22% of the genome in homeolog blocks

Auto-like or allo-like?

Allo-like (disomic-like): the duplicated sets do not interchange, from homeolog pairs (pair-depth CV 0.13). This is also what a long-rediploidized autopolyploid looks like.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 16 chromosome numbers assessed: 10 split into lineages, 0 tetrasomic-like, 4 one divergent copy, 2 candidate

TE markers

Only the absolute marker fraction is available (two copies per number); it does not separate diploid, auto- and allopolyploid, so no reading is made from it.

Confidence: not assessable. Evidence: te_marker_fraction mean 0.3535

Rediploidization

Advanced: no stretch where homeologs are as close as alleles, and the karyotype has been rearranged since the duplication. Also: 7 chromosome(s) carry blocks homeologous to two or more others (chr02:chr21+chr31, chr07:chr08+chr11, chr08:chr07+chr16+chr26, chr09:chr13+chr22, chr11:chr07+chr12, chr16:chr03+chr08, chr21:chr02+chr30): fusions, fissions or translocations since the duplication; homeolog blocks diverged to different depths (CV 0.42), as when regions resolve at different times; homeologous-exchange candidates on 13 chromosome(s), stretches closer to the homeolog than to the own homolog (exchange, or a contig placed on the wrong chromosome).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: residual tetrasomy on 0/28 homeolog-paired chromosome numbers; pair-depth CV 0.13; homeology map: 22% of the genome in 63 homeolog blocks, 17 chromosome pairs, block-divergence CV 0.42; exchange: chr01(chr25:1/2);chr02(chr21:1/2;chr31:1/2);chr09(chr13:1/2);chr14(chr29:1/2);chr16(chr03:1/2);chr17(chr04:1/2);chr18(chr20:1/2);chr21(chr02:1/2);chr25(chr01:1/2);chr29(chr14:1/2);chr30(chr32:1/2);chr31(chr02:2/2);chr32(chr30:1/2)

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair. Red outlines mark individually FDR-accepted pairs from the homeolog test below. See INTERPRETATION.md's "checkerboard" section.
